mo.per.long: Long history from 2023 (excluding Kraken and Gemini)
mo.chart.share.unit: per cent of volumes against all fiat currencies, weekly data
mo.chart.vol: Volumes against the euro in absolute terms
mo.chart.vol.unit: billions of stablecoin units (roughly dollars) per week
mo.rule: Rule: gap of more than 2 standard deviations over the previous 52 weeks, for both the EUR share and the volume against the euro, with the same sign. "To be checked" when only one of the two gaps exceeds 2.
mo.hero.label: EUR share of {s} volumes, week of {d}
mo.hero.range: {chg} percentage points on the previous week · 52-week average {avg}
mo.hero.state.signal: Flag: the EUR share and the volume against the euro both deviate by more than 2 standard deviations, with the same sign (share {sq}, volume {sv}).
mo.hero.state.check: To be checked: only one of the two gaps exceeds 2 standard deviations (share {sq}, volume {sv}).
mo.hero.state.none: No flag: both gaps are within 2 standard deviations (share {sq}, volume {sv}).
mo.hero.state.short: No flag can be computed: the series does not yet have 52 weeks of history.
mo.hero.state.na: The flag status is not available for this week.
mo.alt.share: Weekly EUR share over {n} weeks. {s}: high of {max} in the week of {wMax}, low of {min} in the week of {wMin}.
mo.alt.vol: Weekly volumes against the euro: highest {max} in the week of {wMax}, lowest {min} in the week of {wMin}.
